raw_text: Chinese tracking vessel Yuan Wang 5 detected entering Indian EEZ near Andaman Islands. AIS transponder intermittently disabled over past 48 hours. Indian Navy P-8I Maritime Patrol Aircraft deployed for surveillance. This is the same vessel that caused diplomatic tensions when it docked at Hambantota, Sri Lanka in 2022. Position last reported at 10.2N, 92.8E.
